scope.icons: Every registered icon identifier from the three places the core registers them: the T3Icons set in typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/T3Icons/icons.json with its aliases, every typo3/sysext/*/Configuration/Icons.php, and the flag images under typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/Flags/. Each entry names its source. Complete for all three.
scope.labels: The English trans-units of all 136 default XLF files that sit directly in a system extension's Resources/Private/Language/, across the core. Files in subdirectories of that path are not included; typo3_label_lookup with mode "derive" still computes their translation domain.
scope.components: Hand-curated backend UI components from the styleguide and the backend Sass sources. A subset: not every CSS class in the core is described here.
